name: Thurman's Sewing Kit
summary: At Larson Clothiers, Thurman's Sewing Kit is needed for his tailoring work. The tools belong to young apprentice Thurman Schneider, who left them behind at his family's canal home to avoid a long day of stitching.

sections.title: A Reluctant Apprentice's Tools
sections.body: Thurman's Sewing Kit holds the everyday tools of an apprentice tailor: needles, shears, and thread. Young Thurman Schneider studies tailoring at Larson Clothiers, deep in Stormwind's Mage Quarter near the Mage Tower. His mother, Rema Schneider, knows he cannot do his work without the kit, so she asks passersby along the Canals to carry it to the shop. When Thurman gets the tools, his reaction shows he left them behind on purpose, hoping to trade a day of stitching garments for leisure.

faq.q: What is inside Thurman's Sewing Kit?
faq.answer: The kit holds needles, shears, and thread, the tools Thurman Schneider needs for his tailoring work at Larson Clothiers.

faq.q: Who does this sewing kit belong to?
faq.answer: The kit belongs to Thurman Schneider, a young apprentice working under the Larsons in Stormwind's Mage Quarter.

faq.q: Why was the kit left behind at Thurman's home?
aliases: why did thurman forget his kit
faq.answer: Rema thought Thurman had rushed out and forgotten the kit, but he left it behind on purpose, hoping to avoid his work at Larson Clothiers for the day.

faq.q: Where does this kit need to be delivered?
aliases: where do i take the kit
faq.answer: Take the kit to Larson Clothiers, deep in Stormwind City's Mage Quarter near the Mage Tower.

angles.text: Every tailor knows the drudgery of early apprenticeship, though few go so far as young Thurman Schneider and leave their shears behind.
